title: Per-tenant call-count gate for derived work
description:
What: a CI test that proves one change costs calls proportional to the change, at 200 and 5,000 rows, and at 1 and 50 tenants. Rule: derived work is computed once on change. Covers the intake scan and the reader snapshot read; links PPY-ee02b8 and PPY-7f1e54 for the home-page snapshot.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Cost does not grow with corpus or tenant count
  Given 5,000 References across 50 tenants
  When one Reference changes
  Then the number of AppSync calls equals the count for 200 References

comments.author: home
comments.text: The 50-tenant half of this test needs PPY-ce6207 (tenant keys); the load test PPY-4a79f9 runs it on the staging shared stack. Milestone M1 covers the 1-tenant half.
